title: Comprehensive Final Test — Chapter 11 Data Analysis and Displays

questions.prompt: Which measure of center is most affected by an outlier?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mean is most affected because it includes every value in the calculation.

questions.prompt: The median of the data set 3, 5, 1, 5, 1, 1, 2, 3, 15 is ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The ordered list is 1,1,1,2,3,3,5,5,15; the median is 3.

questions.prompt: What is the range of the data set 19, 20, 21, 22, 22, 24, 25, 25, 27, 27, 32, 48?
In the standard deviation formula, what is the mean of the squared deviations called?
If every value in a data set is multiplied by 4, what happens to the standard deviation?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The standard deviation is also multiplied by 4.

questions.prompt: If 10 is added to every value in a data set, the range ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range stays the same because both the maximum and minimum increase by 10.

questions.prompt: Which measure of center can be used for non‑numerical data?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The mode can be used for non‑numerical data, such as favorite color.

questions.prompt: A data set has a mean of 40. Each value is increased by 12. What is the new mean?
What is the five‑number summary of a data set?
options: Mean, median, mode, range, standard deviation
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The five‑number summary is minimum, Q1, median, Q3, maximum.

questions.prompt: In a box-and-whisker plot, the box is drawn from Q1 to Q3, and the line inside the box represents the ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The line inside the box is the median.

questions.prompt: For the backpacker ages 18, 22, 22, 24, 25, 25, 25, 27, 28, 30, 30, 30, what is Q1?
What is the interquartile range (IQR) of a data set with Q1=15 and Q3=27?
What percentage of the data lies in the box of a box-and-whisker plot?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The box contains the middle 50% of the data.

questions.prompt: If the left whisker is longer than the right whisker, the distribution is skewed ___.
A box-and-whisker plot of song lengths has min=160, Q1=220, median=250, Q3=280, max=300. What is the range?
In a double box-and-whisker plot, which measure indicates which data set has a higher typical value?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The median indicates the typical value.

questions.prompt: Entrée prices have Q1=10.5 and Q3=14.75. The IQR is ___ dollars.
A histogram has a longer tail on the right and most of the data on the left. What is the shape? (skewed left, symmetric, or skewed right)
For a skewed distribution, which measure of center should you use?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Use the median for skewed data.

questions.prompt: State the Empirical Rule: For bell‑shaped data, about ___% of the data lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean.
A bell‑shaped distribution has mean 100 and standard deviation 15. Between what two values do about 95% of the data lie? (Type like 70 and 130)
In a two-way table, the numbers inside the table are called:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The numbers inside the table are joint frequencies.

questions.prompt: The sums of the rows and columns in a two-way table are called ___ frequencies.
A two-way table has row totals of 70 and 80. What is the grand total?
To find a conditional relative frequency, divide a joint frequency by a:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Divide by a row total or column total (a marginal frequency).

questions.prompt: A two-way table shows that 80% of cat owners also own a dog, while only 20% of non‑cat owners own a dog. This suggests an ___ between cat and dog ownership.
Are the weights of bears at a zoo qualitative or quantitative data?
What type of graph is best for showing qualitative data as parts of a whole?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A circle graph (pie chart) is best for showing parts of a whole.

questions.prompt: A graph that exaggerates differences by not starting the scale at zero is called a ___ graph.
To display the distribution of test scores in intervals, which type of graph should you use?
